TITLE: Reeves urges supermarkets to cap grocery prices
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-19
SOURCE: Daily Telegraph

KEY:
- Chancellor Rachel Reeves pressuring UK supermarkets to cap food prices
- Effort to limit inflation unleashed by Iran war
- BBC Politics confirms: "Supermarkets urged to limit food prices by government"

GUARDIAN PARALLEL (May 19):
- UK supermarkets urged to consider voluntary price caps on essential foods
- SNP pledged to use devolved public health powers to fix prices on 20-50 items (bread, milk, cheese, eggs, etc.)
- Iran war driving food price inflation; Ed Davey (Lib Dem) had asked at PMQs about food security
- Davey: food prices would rise by 10% this year as "farmers' costs soar"
- Davey urged government to introduce Good Food Bill — long-term food security targets

CONTEXT:
- Iran war disrupting global supply chains, oil prices, gas prices
- Brent crude at $107.95 morning of May 19
- Sterling firmed to $1.3310
- Cabinet ring-fence around Starmer holding
- Burnham confirmed Makerfield candidate
- HS2 £102.7bn cost confirmed
